svg.aria-label: A curve showing what the same objection costs depending on when it arrives. Raised in week one, during the review window, it costs an afternoon. Raised around month two it costs a sprint. Raised after launch it costs the project. The curve is nearly flat through the review window and then rises steeply.
svg.text: THE SAME OBJECTION, COSTED BY WHEN IT ARRIVES
